name: Ground Throws
summary: Throw a guarding opponent and learn when a throw can connect.
description: Throw a guarding opponent and learn when a throw can connect.

pages.title: Normal Throws
pages.text: Stand close to a grounded opponent, hold toward or away, and press {btn:C}. A normal throw beats guard and has no universal throw-break input. If the opponent has already jumped clear, the ground throw misses and leaves you open.

pages.title: Tick Throws
pages.text: You cannot throw someone while an attack has them stuck reeling or blocking. Make them block a quick attack, stay close while blockstun runs out, then grab them the moment they're free. This is called a tick throw.

feedback.success: Throws beat guard when you are close enough.
feedback.failure: Stand close, hold toward or away, and press C.

tasks.label: Make them block {input:5A}, wait, then throw
tasks.prompt: Make the dummy block {input:5A} (or {input:66A}) - the pushback slides it out of throw range. WALK forward to close the gap, then throw.

feedback.success: Good timing - blockstun ran out and the throw connected before they could press anything.
feedback.failure: If the throw misses, wait a little longer after the blocked 5A.

cue.text: The dummy will guard strikes. Throws still beat guard.
Make 5A get blocked, pause briefly, then throw.
